_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#7. <cp>3.5</cp> inside `ideal gas` gives 'tag "cp" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"' with 'Reading file ...FAILED!' — the FEFunction1D slot needs <cp type="const"><value>3.5</value></cp>. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'cp_needs_type_attr=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
